message.content:
The episode where Del Boy falls through the bar is **"Yuppy Love"**, the first episode of Series 6, which originally aired on **January 8, 1989**.

In this iconic scene, Del Boy (played by Sir David Jason) and Trigger (played by Roger Lloyd Pack) are in a trendy wine bar trying to impress two women. Del tells Trigger to "play it nice and cool, son, nice and cool," but as he goes to lean on the bar, he doesn't notice that the barman has lifted the counter hatch. He falls straight through the bar flap and disappears from view, while Trigger looks around wondering where he's gone.

This scene has been voted the funniest sitcom moment of all time in multiple polls. Interestingly, writer John Sullivan originally wanted Del to simply stumble and catch himself, based on a real-life incident he'd witnessed. However, David Jason insisted on falling all the way through, drawing on his experience in stage farces. The scene was also reportedly almost improvised when Roger Lloyd Pack turned up unannounced on the filming day and was written into the sequence.

The episode also introduced Cassandra Parry (Rodney's future wife) and featured Del adopting a yuppie image inspired by Gordon Gekko from the film *Wall Street*.
